title: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have refresh delays
impact: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have seen refresh delays.

updates.content:
Title: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have refresh delays

User impact: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have refresh delays. 

More info: This includes the following usage reports:
- Microsoft 365 Apps Usage
- Active Users 
- Exchange Email 
- Mailbox
- Email Apps 
 
The last updated date for these reports may be October 18th, 2026, or later depending on the report.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 suite and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have refresh delays

User impact: Admin usage reports for Microsoft 365 apps and Exchange Online may have refresh delays. 

More info: This includes the following usage reports:
- Microsoft 365 Apps Usage
- Active Users 
- Exchange Email 
- Mailbox
- Email Apps 
 
The last updated date for these reports may be October 18th, 2026, or later depending on the report.

Current status: We've identified through our service-side telemetry that the reporting data as identified in the "More info" section of this communication are delayed. We're applying a remediation action through working with our upstream data provider to correct this delay. 

Scope of impact: Admins who review Microsoft 365 reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted and see delayed reporting information. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Friday, October 23, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An issue with the pipeline for our upstream data source responsible for timely report data in the admin center is causing reporting delays.

Next update by: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC
